grammar_title: 直接引语和间接引语(Direct Speech & Indirect Speech)
source: 人教版2019选择性必修三 Unit 3 Discovering Useful Structures:把直接引语变间接引语(陈述句/疑问句/祈使句)。铁律:时态后移、人称变换、指示词/时间状语呼应;疑问句用陈述语序。句子地道、环保主题、答案唯一。

points.point: 陈述句的间接引语(say/tell + that;时态后移、人称变换)
points.overview: 直接引语是陈述句时,用 that 引导(可省略),主句一般过去时则从句时态相应后移(do→did, is→was, will→would, have done→had done),人称随说话人/听话人变换。

points.point: 疑问句的间接引语(一般疑问→if/whether;特殊疑问→wh-词;一律陈述语序)
points.overview: 一般疑问句转述用 if/whether 引导;特殊疑问句保留 wh- 疑问词;两者都要变成「陈述语序」(主语在前、动词在后,不再倒装),并完成时态后移与人称变换。

points.point: 祈使句的间接引语(tell/ask/order/advise sb (not) to do)+ 时间/地点状语呼应
points.overview: 祈使句转述用 tell/ask/order/advise + sb + (not) to do;同时时间/地点指示词要呼应:now→then, today→that day, tomorrow→the next day, here→there, this→that。

questions.stem: He said, "I recycle paper every week." → He said that he ____ paper every week.
questions.explanation: 主句 said 过去时,从句一般现在 recycle 后移为一般过去 recycled;人称 I→he。

questions.stem: She said, "The air is getting cleaner." → She said that the air ____ getting cleaner.
questions.explanation: 现在进行 is getting 后移为过去进行 was getting。

questions.stem: The expert said, "Polar bears will die out." → The expert said that polar bears ____ die out.
questions.explanation: will 后移为 would。

questions.stem: Tom said, "I have planted ten trees." → Tom said that he ____ ten trees.
questions.explanation: 现在完成 have planted 后移为过去完成 had planted。

questions.stem: She said, "We can save a lot of water." → She said that they ____ save a lot of water.
questions.explanation: can 后移为 could;人称 we→they。

questions.stem: He told me, "The factory released waste gas." → He told me that the factory ____ released waste gas.
questions.explanation: 一般过去 released 后移为过去完成 had released。

questions.stem: Lily said, "I am cutting my carbon footprint." → Lily said that she ____ cutting her carbon footprint.
questions.explanation: 现在进行 am cutting 后移为过去进行 was cutting;人称 I→she。

questions.stem: They said, "The river is badly polluted." → They said that the river ____ badly polluted.
questions.explanation: is 后移为 was;主语 the river 单数。

questions.stem: He said, "I don't waste electricity at home." → He said that he ____ waste electricity at home.
questions.explanation: 一般现在否定 don't 后移为一般过去 didn't。

questions.stem: She said, "Smog has become a serious problem." → She said that smog ____ become a serious problem.
questions.explanation: 现在完成 has become 后移为过去完成 had become。

questions.stem: Ben said, "We are going to plant more trees." → Ben said that they ____ going to plant more trees.
questions.explanation: be going to 中的 are 后移为 were;人称 we→they。

questions.stem: The girl said, "I will turn off the lights." → The girl said that she ____ turn off the lights.
questions.explanation: will 后移为 would;人称 I→she。

questions.stem: He said, "People throw too much garbage away." → He said that people ____ too much garbage away.
questions.explanation: 一般现在 throw 后移为一般过去 threw。

questions.stem: Mum said, "The ice is melting fast." → Mum said that the ice ____ melting fast.
questions.explanation: is melting 后移为 was melting。

questions.stem: She said, "I have never used a plastic bag." → She said that she ____ never used a plastic bag.
questions.explanation: 现在完成 have used 后移为过去完成 had used。

questions.stem: He said, "Clean energy can sustain our future." → He said that clean energy ____ sustain their future.
questions.explanation: can 后移为 could。

questions.stem: The reporter said, "The smog killed many people." → The reporter said that the smog ____ killed many people.
questions.explanation: 一般过去 killed 后移为过去完成 had killed。

questions.stem: Sara said, "I am saving water at home." → Sara said that she ____ saving water at home.
questions.explanation: am saving 后移为 was saving;人称 I→she。

questions.stem: They said, "We don't burn coal any more." → They said that they ____ burn coal any more.
questions.explanation: 一般现在否定 don't 后移为一般过去 didn't。

questions.stem: He said, "The trees will protect the soil." → He said that the trees ____ protect the soil.
questions.explanation: will 后移为 would。

questions.stem: She asked, "Do you save water at home?" → She asked ____ I saved water at home.
questions.explanation: 一般疑问句转述用 if/whether 引导,并变陈述语序。

questions.stem: He asked, "What can we do to help?" → He asked what we ____ do to help.
questions.explanation: 特殊疑问句保留 what,用陈述语序,can 后移为 could。

questions.stem: The reporter asked, "Will polar bears die out?" → The reporter asked ____ polar bears would die out.
questions.explanation: 一般疑问句用 whether 引导;will 后移为 would。

questions.stem: She asked, "Why is smog so harmful?" → She asked why smog ____ so harmful.
questions.explanation: 保留 why,陈述语序,is 后移为 was。

questions.stem: He asked, "How do you cut carbon emissions?" → He asked how I ____ carbon emissions.
questions.explanation: 陈述语序去掉助动词 do,cut 后移仍为 cut(原形=过去式)。

questions.stem: They asked, "Are the rivers getting cleaner?" → They asked ____ the rivers were getting cleaner.
questions.explanation: 一般疑问句用 whether 引导,变陈述语序。

questions.stem: She asked, "Where does the smog come from?" → She asked where the smog ____ from.
questions.explanation: 陈述语序、去 does,comes 后移为 came。

questions.stem: He asked, "Can we still save the forest?" → He asked ____ we could still save the forest.
questions.explanation: 一般疑问句用 if 引导;can 后移为 could。

questions.stem: The teacher asked, "What causes climate change?" → The teacher asked what ____ climate change.
questions.explanation: what 作主语,causes 后移为 caused。

questions.stem: She asked, "Have you joined the clean-up?" → She asked ____ I had joined the clean-up.
questions.explanation: 一般疑问句用 whether 引导;have joined 后移为 had joined。

questions.stem: He asked, "When will the new policy start?" → He asked when the new policy ____ start.
questions.explanation: 保留 when,陈述语序,will 后移为 would。

questions.stem: They asked, "Why did the factory close?" → They asked why the factory ____ closed.
questions.explanation: 保留 why、陈述语序;一般过去 did close 后移为 had closed。

questions.stem: She asked, "Do the villagers recycle waste?" → She asked if the villagers ____ waste.
questions.explanation: if 引导、陈述语序、去 do;recycle 后移为 recycled。

questions.stem: He asked, "How much water do we waste?" → He asked how much water we ____.
questions.explanation: 陈述语序去 do;waste 后移为 wasted。

questions.stem: The expert asked, "Is nuclear power safe?" → The expert asked ____ nuclear power was safe.
questions.explanation: 一般疑问句用 whether 引导;is 后移为 was。

questions.stem: She asked, "What are you doing for the planet?" → She asked what I ____ doing for the planet.
questions.explanation: 陈述语序;am doing 后移为 was doing(I→第三人称由说话人决定,这里转述者用 was)。

questions.stem: He asked, "Can the river be cleaned up?" → He asked ____ the river could be cleaned up.
questions.explanation: 一般疑问句用 whether 引导;can 后移为 could。

questions.stem: They asked, "How has the air improved?" → They asked how the air ____ improved.
questions.explanation: 保留 how;现在完成 has improved 后移为过去完成 had improved。

questions.stem: She asked, "Do we need stricter rules?" → She asked if we ____ stricter rules.
questions.explanation: if 引导、陈述语序、去 do;need 后移为 needed。

questions.stem: He asked, "Which energy is cleaner?" → He asked which energy ____ cleaner.
questions.explanation: 保留 which,陈述语序,is 后移为 was。

questions.stem: "Turn off the lights, please," she said. → She told us ____ off the lights.
questions.explanation: 祈使句转述用 tell sb to do。

questions.stem: "Don't throw garbage into the river," he said. → He told the tourists ____ throw garbage into the river.
questions.explanation: 否定祈使句用 tell sb not to do。

questions.stem: "Please save water," the teacher said. → The teacher asked us ____ water.
questions.explanation: ask sb to do 转述请求型祈使句。

questions.stem: "Let's work together to stop pollution," the expert said. → The expert advised us ____ together to stop pollution.
questions.explanation: advise sb to do 转述建议型祈使句。

questions.stem: "Stop burning coal now," the officer said. → The officer ordered them to stop burning coal ____.
questions.explanation: 时间状语呼应:now→then。

questions.stem: "Plant more trees here," she said. → She told us to plant more trees ____.
questions.explanation: 地点状语呼应:here→there。

questions.stem: "Recycle this bottle," he said. → He told me to recycle ____ bottle.
questions.explanation: 指示词呼应:this→that。

questions.stem: "Submit your report tomorrow," the teacher said. → The teacher told us to submit our report ____.
questions.explanation: 时间状语呼应:tomorrow→the next day。

questions.stem: "Don't waste electricity," Mum said. → Mum told me ____ electricity.
questions.explanation: 否定祈使句用 tell sb not to do。

questions.stem: "Use cloth bags instead of plastic," she said. → She advised us ____ cloth bags instead of plastic.
questions.explanation: advise sb to do 转述建议。

questions.stem: "Don't print documents unless necessary," Sally said. → Sally asked us ____ documents unless necessary.
questions.explanation: 否定祈使句用 ask sb not to do。

questions.stem: "Take shorter showers today," he said. → He told them to take shorter showers ____.
questions.explanation: 时间状语呼应:today→that day。

questions.stem: "Walk or ride a bike," Jack said. → Jack advised me ____ or ride a bike.
questions.explanation: advise sb to do 转述建议。

questions.stem: "Keep this room clean," she said. → She told us to keep ____ room clean.
questions.explanation: 指示词呼应:this→that。

questions.stem: "Turn off the heater now," Dad said. → Dad ordered us to turn off the heater ____.
questions.explanation: 时间状语呼应:now→then。

questions.stem: "Don't drop litter here," the guard said. → The guard told us not to drop litter ____.
questions.explanation: 地点状语呼应:here→there。

questions.stem: "Please share books with others," Joe said. → Joe asked us ____ books with others.
questions.explanation: ask sb to do 转述请求。

questions.stem: "Clean up the beach tomorrow," she said. → She told the volunteers to clean up the beach ____.
questions.explanation: 时间状语呼应:tomorrow→the next day。

questions.stem: "Don't use the car for short trips," he said. → He advised us ____ the car for short trips.
questions.explanation: 否定祈使句用 advise sb not to do。

questions.stem: "Plant this tree carefully," the worker said. → The worker told the boy to plant ____ tree carefully.
questions.explanation: 指示词呼应:this→that。
